    • subscribeTaskEvents

      public AutoCloseable subscribeTaskEvents(Consumer<WorkspaceTaskGateway.TaskEvent> listener)
      Description copied from interface: WorkspaceTaskGateway
      Subscribes to asynchronous task state changes. Implementations that do not have a push transport may retain the default no-op; polling remains the compatibility path through WorkspaceTaskGateway.find(UUID, UUID) and WorkspaceTaskGateway.logs(UUID, UUID).
